summary.tldr: Bill C-5 would repeal some mandatory minimum penalties, allow more conditional sentences, and create diversion measures for simple drug possession.
what_it_does: Repeals certain mandatory minimum penalties in the Criminal Code and the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act.
Allows greater use of conditional sentences, which are sentences served in the community under court conditions.
Establishes diversion measures for simple drug possession offences.
who_it_affects: People accused of simple drug possession
summary.background: The Minister of Justice introduced the bill in the House of Commons on 7 December 2021, and it received first reading.
